summary: Deleting and revoking access is more precise and better guarded, with new limits you control.

new.title: Limits for bulk revoke and admin delete
new.text: You can set bulk-revoke and admin-delete limits on the Guards page.

new.title: Central admin delete for MSPs
new.text: In an MSP setup, a central admin can be deleted with the managing tenant SuperAdmin's approval, one per run.

fixes.title: Deletes and revokes act precisely
fixes.text: An account delete acts once on the exact account, and deleting and revoking follow scope and level everywhere.

fixes.title: Sponsors propose, others approve
fixes.text: A sponsor proposes a change and someone with permission approves it, never the sponsor themselves.

fixes.title: Large withdrawals are held
fixes.text: Withdrawals from managed tenants above the customer limit are held on the Guards page, and a SuperAdmin can release every hold.

fixes.title: Mails name the environment
fixes.text: Mails show the environment name, never a bare tenant id.
